title: LA DeepBlack 101 Solo – UV Brushstroke
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing, deepest ebony skin with cool blue-black undertones, mid 40s, spoon-shape physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE — hips dramatically wider than the upper body, full belly, full bust, enormous thighs, UV-reactive red sleek low bun — full body UV neon ink brushstroke body art from neck to ankle, EVERY inch covered, NO bare skin below neck. Bold black outlines — ELECTRIC RED and ORANGE sweeping calligraphic brush strokes (abstract, no letters) across torso and both legs to ankle, VIVID GOLD splatter dots, filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: contrapposto, one foot on a low black block, hand on raised knee, torso upright facing camera, chest and belly fully visible.
Footwear: red gold platform gladiator stiletto sandals laced to mid-calf 8 inch. Nails: extra long stiletto nails, neon red brushstroke.
Extreme high-gloss oil. MANDATORY pure pitch black background only, NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. CRITICAL: legs show FULL BODY ART coverage hip to ankle to toe. UV brushstroke art must BLAZE against the deepest ebony skin. Emphasis on the extreme body volume. 8K portrait 2:3 vertical.
